name: M3 — Chat on mobile: read, send, stream (and fix the missing ChatEntryMobile)
description:
MILESTONE M3 (blocked: needs M1 + strategy decision).
Vertical slice: "chat is usable on the phone: read the conversation, send a message, see the answer stream in".

SCOPE
- Fix the broken mobile message rendering: src/components/ChatEntry.vue imports ./ChatEntryMobile.vue and that file DOES NOT EXIST (blocker, confirmed in the audit) — either create it or delete the fork and make ChatEntry responsive.
- Chat on small screens: conversation full width, fixed composer above the safe area, message actions (copy, retry, stop) reachable, code blocks scroll horizontally instead of overflowing.
- Chat list → conversation navigation with back, chatId/chatName already in the route (verify refresh keeps the conversation).
- Keyboard behaviour: composer stays visible when the on-screen keyboard opens (visual viewport), no 100vh jump.

OUT OF SCOPE
Changes panel / PR review, workspace-in-chat, team DMs.

DEPLOYABLE + DEMOABLE
Demo: open a real chat, send a message, see the response arrive, copy a code block — all on a phone.

ACCEPTANCE
- The import error is gone and `npm run build` passes.
- Sending a message works on a 375 px viewport with the keyboard open.
- No horizontal page scroll in the conversation.
